info.title: TestArmy API
info.description: AI-powered browser automation API for QA testing. Automate web testing workflows using natural language prompts.

bearerAuth.description: API key authentication using Bearer token format. The CLI's `ta auth` access tokens are also accepted; because they name a user rather than a workspace, a user in several workspaces selects one with the `x-testerarmy-team` header (workspace id or slug).

browserRegion.description: Default exit region for web runs. null uses the default, us (static IPs). us-dynamic exits from a US IP that usually changes between runs. Web projects only.

prTestingInstructions.description: Free-form instructions for the PR exploration agent.

agentInstructions.description: Free-form instructions injected into the QA agent's system prompt on every run of this project.

prTestingDebounceMinutes.description: Quiet period before a PR deployment is tested. 0 disables debouncing.

prTestingBlockMerge.description: Conclude the GitHub check run as failed when tests fail, so a required TesterArmy check blocks the merge. Off by default.

includeExampleMobileApp.description: Offer the example app as a run target. Mobile projects only.

autoDeleteOldestMobileApp.description: Delete the oldest unused app builds when an upload exceeds the storage quota. Mobile projects only.

accessibilityAuditEnabled.description: Scan visited pages with axe-core during web runs and report critical accessibility violations as non-blocking warnings. On by default. Web projects only.

deeplink.description: Deep link the test harness opens on the device after launching the app and before any test step runs (e.g. an Expo update-channel or backend-selection link). Applied deterministically; the QA agent is told the setup is already done.

goal.description: The exploration goal for the free-roam QA agent, e.g. "Explore the checkout flow and find bugs". The agent decides what to test; there is no predefined step list.

targetUrl.description: Optional URL to explore instead of the project's production URL. Web only.

platform.description: Target platform; defaults to web. Mobile platforms explore the uploaded app.

appId.description: Uploaded mobile app ID to explore. Defaults to the project's latest app for the platform.

deviceModel.description: Mobile device variant within the platform (e.g. ipad on iOS). Omit for the default phone-sized device.

status.description: Triage status. Resolved issues reopen automatically if a run surfaces them again.

source.description: How the tracker learned about the issue: an explicit agent report or a failed test step.

environment.description: Deployment bucket the issue is tracked on.

environmentName.description: Resolved environment label ("Production", "Staging", "QA EU", ...). Issues are tracked per environment: the same bug on different environments is separate issues.

occurrenceCount.description: Number of runs that surfaced this issue.

tMs.description: Recording offset (ms) when the issue was reported in that run.

executionMode.description: Deprecated and ignored. Deep mode was removed; every run uses the same mode.

browserRegion.description: Per-test proxy exit region. null falls back to the project's region.

simulatorRegion.description: Region the simulator or emulator runs in. Mobile tests only.

viewport.description: Browser viewport preset: desktop (1280x800), desktop-hd (1920x1080), mobile (390x844), tablet (768x1024). null restores the default. Web tests only.

webSearchEnabled.description: Allow the test to use internet search for factual checks.

prepGroupId.description: Group whose preparation test a solo run of this test uses.

title.description: Action to perform. Reference a project file for upload by writing @ followed by its exact filename (e.g. @receipt.jpg); the run resolves it by name.

disabled.description: When true, the step stays saved on the test but is skipped during runs.

code.description: JavaScript run in the browser page. Runs as an awaited function body; passes unless it throws or returns { success: false, reason }; any other return value, including diagnostic data, counts as a pass. Web tests only.

disabled.description: When true, the step stays saved on the test but is skipped during runs.

fileId.description: Project file ID (UUID) of the audio file (e.g. MP3) to play through the microphone. Empty string marks an unconfigured draft that must have a file attached before the test runs.

mode.description: blocking: the agent waits for playback to finish before continuing. loop: playback repeats until the run ends and the agent continues immediately. Web tests only.

disabled.description: When true, the step stays saved on the test but is skipped during runs.

maxConcurrentRuns.description: Concurrent groups only: max tests executing at once per group run. Capped at your team's concurrent-run limit; null follows the plan limit.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the cron is evaluated in.

cronExpression.description: The 5-field cron the scheduler runs, derived from the preset or given as custom.

projectEnvironmentId.description: Saved environment the schedule runs against; null runs Production.

frequency.description: Preset cadence. The interval presets take `minute`; `daily` adds `hour`; `weekly` adds `hour` and `dayOfWeek`; `custom` takes `cronExpression`.

minute.description: Minute of the hour (0-59). Defaults to 0. Ignored for custom.

hour.description: Hour of the day (0-23) in `timezone`. Required for daily and weekly.

dayOfWeek.description: 0 = Sunday through 6 = Saturday. Required for weekly.

cronExpression.description: Standard 5-field cron (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week), e.g. "*/30 * * * *" for every 30 minutes. Seconds are not supported. Required for custom.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the schedule is evaluated in, e.g. "Europe/Warsaw". Defaults to UTC.

name.description: Display name shown in the dashboard.

projectEnvironmentId.description: Saved environment the schedule runs against, from the project's environments. Omit or pass null for Production. PR Preview cannot be scheduled.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for fetching the next page

deviceModel.description: Mobile device the run used (iOS: iphone | ipad). Null for web runs and platforms without device variants.

output.description: Run output when completed or skipped

instructions.description: Natural language instructions for the QA agent

focusAreas.description: Focus areas derived from changed files

changeType.description: Classify this PR: frontend = UI/component changes, backend = API/DB/service changes with no visible UI effect, mixed = both, infra = CI/config/docs only

title.description: Concise description of what to do or verify
Concise description of what to do or verify
Concise description of the login step

credentialId.description: ID of the credential to use

temporaryEmail.description: Set to true to create a temporary email inbox at run time

title.description: Description of what page state to capture

type.description: Capture visual evidence of the current page state

steps.description: Ordered list of concrete test steps the agent must execute one-by-one

executionConfig.description: Pre-run execution configuration selected by the planner.

stage.description: Run lifecycle stage where the error occurred (e.g. provider_acquisition)

retryable.description: Whether re-running the test could succeed without changes

stepResults.description: Step-level results for structured test runs

userName.description: Display name of the user who triggered the run

externalRef.description: External integration metadata (e.g. GitHub PR/deployment IDs)

executionMode.description: Execution mode used for this run

autoRetryCount.description: Number of times the run was automatically retried after a temporary failure. Failed attempts are not counted toward usage.

featureName.description: Name of the feature being tested

result.description: Test result - PASS if no issues found, FAILED if any issues were reported, BLOCKED if an environment/setup problem or an automation limitation prevented a product verdict

description.description: Short summary of what was tested and the final result; include a compact grouped issue summary only when the user explicitly asks for one

issues.description: Issues reported during the session via the report_issue tool

screenshots.description: Array of screenshot URLs captured during testing

uiActionIntervals.description: Recording-time windows when the agent was visibly acting on screen (clicks, typing, scrolling, navigation); used by replay smart speed

storageKey.description: Internal storage key of the recording artifact

recording.description: Pointer to the run's video recording artifact, present on completed runs that captured a recording. The bytes are not fetchable through the public API; use the dashboard or a share link to view the recording.

category.description: Why the run was blocked: an environment/setup problem or an automation limitation

summary.description: Plain-language explanation of what blocked the run

errorCodes.description: Step error codes that produced the blocked verdict

BlockedReason.description: Structured explanation, present only when result is BLOCKED

type.description: issue = confirmed bug, warning = non-blocking observation

name.description: Short name of the issue (e.g. 'Login form rejects valid email')

description.description: What was tested, what happened, and what was expected

url.description: Where the issue happened: the exact page URL on web, or the app identifier and screen on mobile (e.g. com.example.app/login)

reproductionSteps.description: Short reproduction steps in execution order

tMs.description: Milliseconds elapsed since the recording reference time when the issue was reported

pageCount.description: Total distinct pages where the rule failed; `urls` is a bounded sample

urls.description: Pages where the rule failed (bounded sample)

sampleTargets.description: CSS selector paths to example failing elements (bounded sample)

IssueAccessibilityDetail.description: Structured detail present on warnings produced by the automated axe-core accessibility audit

startedAtMs.description: Milliseconds elapsed since recording reference when the step started

completedAtMs.description: Milliseconds elapsed since recording reference when the step completed

truncated.description: Actions were dropped at a cap; the trace is guidance-only, never replayable

startPath.description: Pathname where the step began at record time

startScreen.description: Mobile: app under test (bundle id / package name) when the step began

startScreenSignature.description: Mobile: hashed structural signature of the starting screen (shadow data in v1)

gap.description: Placeholder for a tool the recorder saw run but did not capture (tool name only, no payload) - e.g. a file upload or a failed state-changing attempt. Gaps keep the trace honest about what actually happened: during cached replay, read-only gaps are skipped and state-changing gaps stop the replay so the agent performs that part live instead of it being silently skipped

navigated.description: The action changed the page URL at record time; replay keeps its full settle pipeline

allOf.description: Drag-and-drop source endpoint, when the action has two targets

type.description: Mobile: raw platform element class (XCUIElementTypeButton, android.widget.Button)

identifier.description: Mobile: platform identifier when the app sets one (AXUniqueId / resource-id)

label.description: Mobile: stable accessible label (labels mirroring a typed value are excluded)

matchCount.description: Mobile: same-signature match count at record time; relocation rejects when the live count differs

startMs.description: Milliseconds elapsed since the recording reference time when the action began

endMs.description: Milliseconds elapsed since the recording reference time when the action finished

kind.description: Coarse action category; absent on runs recorded before kinds were tracked

stepIndex.description: Zero-based index of the saved test step

startedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the step started

completedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the step completed

startedAtMs.description: Milliseconds elapsed since recording reference when the step started

completedAtMs.description: Milliseconds elapsed since recording reference when the step completed

messages.description: Full agent transcript ordered by creation time

parts.description: Ordered transcript parts: `text`/`reasoning` entries carry what the agent said, `tool` entries carry each tool call with its input and output.

type.description: What the agent said or reasoned

toolName.description: Tool the agent called (e.g. ui_navigate, ui_click)

status.description: Tool call outcome; absent on redacted calls

summary.description: One-line human-readable description of what the tool call did; read these in order to follow the run without parsing raw payloads

output.description: Tool call output when the call completed

errorText.description: Failure description when the call errored

redacted.description: True when a credential-bearing tool call was redacted

console.description: Browser console entries (web) or app log lines (mobile) in capture order

network.description: Network requests in capture order (document, fetch, and XHR prioritized)

droppedConsole.description: Console entries dropped after the buffer cap

droppedNetwork.description: Network entries dropped after the buffer cap

counts.description: Capture counts including entries dropped by ring-buffer limits

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number across console and network entries

level.description: Console level (log, info, warning, error, debug, ...)

url.description: Page URL when the entry was emitted

sourceUrl.description: Script URL that emitted the entry

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number across console and network entries

requestBody.description: JSON request body preview with secrets redacted (fetch/XHR only, truncated)

responseBody.description: JSON response body preview with secrets redacted (fetch/XHR only, truncated)

failure.description: Present when the request failed before receiving a response

status.description: Aggregate batch status: running while any run is in flight, failed when any finished run failed, completed when all finished runs passed, cancelled when every run was cancelled

runs.description: Child runs ordered by creation time

result.description: Test verdict when the run finished with an output. BLOCKED means an environment or setup problem prevented a product verdict

errorCode.description: Run error code when execution failed

put.summary: Create or replace a group's schedule
put.description: Create the group's recurring schedule, or replace the existing one in place. Every time the schedule fires, a run of each enabled test in the group is queued. The scheduler entry is updated before the stored schedule, so a rejected cron leaves the current schedule running. Returns 201 when the group had no schedule and 200 when one was replaced. Web projects only: a mobile project's group returns 400.

get.description: Retrieve console logs and network requests captured during a run. get.description: Download the batch as a JUnit XML report for CI test reporters and test management tools such as TestRail (`trcli parse_junit -f report.xml`). Preparation runs are omitted. Returns 409 until every run has finished unless `allowIncomplete=true` is set.

schema.description: Export a batch with in-flight runs; unfinished runs render as skipped

parameters.description: Export a batch with in-flight runs; unfinished runs render as skipped
parameters.name: allowIncomplete

200.description: JUnit XML report (served as an attachment)

schema.description: JUnit XML document. One `testsuite` per group-run batch (named after the group), one `testcase` per test. Passing runs have no child element; a FAILED verdict is a `<failure>`; BLOCKED verdicts, runs that crashed before a verdict, and runs that finished without one are `<error>` (type `BLOCKED`, the run error code, or `MISSING_VERDICT`); cancelled, planner-skipped, and unfinished runs are `<skipped>`. Each testcase carries `testerarmy_*` properties plus TestRail `testrail_result_comment` and `testrail_result_step` properties, and a `test_id` property when the test title contains `[C123]`-style case ids, so `trcli parse_junit` imports it directly.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing API key

409.description: Conflict - Some runs are still queued or running; pass `allowIncomplete=true` to export as skipped

429.description: Too Many Requests - Usage limit exceeded

504.description: Gateway Timeout - Test execution exceeded time limit
